Develop AEM components, templates, and client libraries (clientlibs) following Adobe best practices. Strong hands-on experience with React (hooks, state management, component architecture), plus modern JavaScript (ES6+) and TypeScript. Solid knowledge of HTML5, CSS3/SASS/LESS, and responsive design. ck, and CI/CD pipelines. Good understanding of accessibility, web performance, and SEO. Excellent communication skills and the ability to work independently in a remote environment.
